pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Oklahoma GPA

officialLinks.label: Grading policies; grade values; retention/graduation GPA

helpIntro: OU uses a 4.0 scale for the Norman-campus undergraduate retention/graduation GPA: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0. Enter credit hours and final grades to estimate current, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: This profile estimates the undergraduate retention/graduation GPA, which can include OU and transfer work. P/S and I/X/U/N/NP/AW/W are excluded. Repeat Impact is unavailable because current OU undergraduate forgiveness can depend on the highest of multiple attempts.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 grade points and a 3-credit B earns 9. Together, 21 ÷ 6 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 grade point per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 grade points; credit hours count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is neutral and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory is neutral and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete carries no grade points and is excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.X: X carries no grade points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory carries no grade points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.N: N carries no grade points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: No Pass carries no grade points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.AW: Administrative Withdrawal carries no grade points and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal carries no grade points and is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: OU or transfer course counted in retention/graduation GPA
specialTypes.note: Use the grade and credit hours as recorded for the OU retention/graduation GPA.

specialTypes.name: Officially reprieved or renewed coursework
specialTypes.note: Select only after OU has officially applied reprieve or renewal; affected coursework is excluded from the retention/graduation GPA.

specialTypes.name: Repeated course needing forgiveness review
specialTypes.note: OU undergraduate repeat forgiveness can depend on equivalency and the highest of multiple attempts; confirm the official adjusted record before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is unavailable. Use your officially adjusted retention/graduation GPA or confirm repeat forgiveness with Academic Records.
